posts.title: New WebSockets Backdoor Likely Targeting Iraq
posts.description: On September 29 2026, @MalwareHunterTeam shared a suspicious low detection file named document.exe, uploaded to VirusTotal from Iraq on that same day. The sample has minimal detection in VirusTotal: Figure 1: Low Detection in VirusTotal.
